tests.title: Photo-wall drive
tests.description: Drive and move across a simple road, with real Peterborough footage turned into photo walls.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows to move · drag to look · touch controls on phones
tests.limitation: Flat facades and visible joins. Street dimensions are illustrative, not surveyed.

tests.title: 360° video drive
tests.description: Look around from the cab, change playback speed and switch to a real recorded return journey.
tests.controls: Drag to look · play and speed controls · turn around
tests.limitation: Fixed camera path. Turning around cuts to an approximately matched location on the return pass.

tests.title: Turn & street · baseline
tests.description: Original 50-second, 250,000-splat turn-and-street experiment.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · capture-height lock · touch controls
tests.limitation: Early reconstruction: blur, vehicle haze and off-path artifacts remain.

tests.title: Turn & street · improved
tests.description: 750,000-splat retraining of the same turn and street.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · capture-height lock · touch controls
tests.limitation: Improved source-view fit is not proof of accurate off-path geometry.

tests.title: 20-second corner · MRNF + GUT
tests.description: The sharper-frame, 20-second corner test with MRNF + GUT.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · capture-height lock · touch controls
tests.limitation: One trained scene; headless/native and aligned exports are coordinate variants, not separate tests.

tests.title: Corner A · box masks
tests.description: 20-second controlled corner comparison using box masks.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · capture-height lock · touch controls
tests.limitation: One stochastic run per arm. Alignment is relative, with no surveyed scale.

tests.title: Corner B · segmentation masks
tests.description: Matching corner comparison using dilated segmentation masks.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · capture-height lock · touch controls
tests.limitation: One stochastic run per arm. Alignment is relative, with no surveyed scale.

tests.title: New footage · half-block
tests.description: 1.5-million-splat reconstruction from opposing passes on the newer recording.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · capture-height lock · touch controls
tests.limitation: Open half-block, not a closed full-block reconstruction. Postshot was not run; quality target not passed.

tests.title: Turn & street · cleanup comparison
tests.description: Conservative cleanup of the improved model, removing 340 splats.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · capture-height lock · touch controls
tests.limitation: Rejected cleanup comparison: tested but not selected as the preferred result.

tests.title: Construction · fixed calibration
tests.description: 5,000-iteration off-path diagnostic using the newer recording.
tests.controls: WASD / arrows · drag to look · capture-height lock · touch controls
tests.limitation: Experimental snapshot from an ongoing study. Geometry plausibility and off-path quality have not passed acceptance.
